instruction: parse_settings in settings.py has two problems. It crashes when a value contains '=', such as a database URL with query parameters (`url = postgres://db/app?sslmode=require`). And a line with no '=' at all fails with a confusing unpacking error: it should raise ValueError("line N: expected key = value"), where N is the 1-based line number. Please fix both. The file uses Windows (CRLF) line endings; keep them.
